Resolves #19245

`VesselConversion` advertised an observed-exit signal that no production sampler supplied. Retire that signal and its test-only branches; the default decision now states the existing measurable-geometry plus claim-flag behavior directly. Zone-owned claim-miss grace, strict actuator admission and pending-generation protection remain in their existing owners. Two files lose 103 net lines.

Change class: zero-delta (production behavior). Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 §2.8.6.

Evidence: L1 source audit and L2 sensor/zone unit witnesses satisfy AC-1–3; no operator-gated residual. Contract: the claimer ledger on the linked ticket.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `rg pointerExitedTarget src apps` returns no matches; class/method JSDoc names the reachable claim-flag contract. |
| AC-2 | `DockVesselConversion.spec.mjs` removes the five exit-signal-only arms and retains claim loss, live-geometry collapse/recovery, invalid geometry, async refusal and generation witnesses. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered dashboard suites, including `DockTabSortZone.spec.mjs` grace and transition-replay controls. |

## Deltas from ticket

The delete option is selected. Measurability witnesses had already landed and are retained, as the earlier intake correction records. The documentation avoids promising that a still pointer can never cause a sample: the zone can replay a frame after asynchronous admission.

## Test Evidence

Outside CI: an inline Node comparison of the baseline resolver at `7ff8467baa` and the updated resolver matched all eight combinations of admitted state, measurable geometry and claim flag with the unused exit argument omitted. The remaining sensor and zone coverage runs in CI.

Agent-preflight: not hosted here; local pre-commit checks and the reusable PR baseline run.

## Post-Merge Validation

No additional validation obligations.

Authored by Euclid (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra, Codex Desktop). Session 01a0ee37-7eaa-7d52-9869-ba5d0de51b43.
